top_bar.style: sticky top-0 z-50 border-b border-white/10 bg-[#050507]/80 backdrop-blur-xl py-3
top_bar.brand_mark: Crisp white square with black text '[ F ]', no gradients. Font: JetBrains Mono.
top_bar.new_chat_btn: Ghost button, px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-white/5, text-sm rounded-md transition-colors text-zinc-400 hover:text-white

welcome_hero.layout: Flex column, centered, generous negative space (py-20 md:py-32)
welcome_hero.title: text-4xl md:text-5xl font-black text-white tracking-tighter. NO GRADIENTS. Solid white.
welcome_hero.subtitle: text-base md:text-lg text-zinc-400 font-body max-w-md mx-auto mt-4
welcome_hero.prompt_cards_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mt-12 w-full max-w-2xl
welcome_hero.prompt_card: p-5 border border-white/10 bg-transparent hover:border-white/40 hover:bg-white/[0.02] transition-all duration-200 text-left flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-sm cursor-pointer group
welcome_hero.prompt_card_category: text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-widest group-hover:text-zinc-300 transition-colors

chat_interface.user_bubble: max-w-[85%] sm:max-w-[75%] bg-white text-black px-5 py-3 rounded-2xl rounded-br-sm text-[15px] font-medium shadow-sm
chat_interface.ai_mark: w-7 h-7 flex-shrink-0 bg-[#0057FF] text-white flex items-center justify-center rounded-sm text-xs font-mono shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,87,255,0.3)]
chat_interface.typing_indicator: A sleek blinking block cursor (██) or monospace 'Decrypting...' text loader. No bouncing dots.

action_card.container: mt-5 border border-white/20 bg-[#0C0C0F] rounded-sm overflow-hidden shadow-2xl
action_card.header: px-4 py-3 border-b border-white/10 flex justify-between items-center bg-white/[0.02]
action_card.header_title: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-2 text-zinc-300
action_card.field_row: flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-baseline gap-1 sm:gap-4 border-b border-white/5 pb-3 last:border-0 last:pb-0
action_card.field_label: text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-500 w-20 shrink-0 uppercase tracking-wider
action_card.footer: px-4 py-3 bg-[#050507] border-t border-white/10 flex justify-end gap-3
action_card.approve_btn: bg-[#0057FF] text-white hover:bg-[#004CE6] px-5 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-sm transition-colors flex items-center gap-2
action_card.cancel_btn: text-zinc-400 hover:text-white px-4 py-2 text-sm transition-colors font-medium rounded-sm hover:bg-white/5

composer.container: relative z-20 border-t border-white/10 bg-[#050507]/90 backdrop-blur-2xl pb-6 pt-4 px-4 sm:px-6
composer.input_wrapper: relative flex items-end gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-[#0C0C0F] focus-within:border-white/50 focus-within:bg-[#0F0F12] transition-all max-w-3xl mx-auto pl-5 pr-2 py-2 shadow-lg
composer.textarea: bg-transparent border-0 text-white text-[15px] min-h-[40px] max-h-32 py-2.5 focus:ring-0 resize-none w-full font-body placeholder:text-zinc-600
composer.send_btn: bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200 h-10 w-10 rounded-full flex-shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:bg-zinc-800 disabled:text-zinc-500
composer.helper_text: text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-500 text-center mt-3 tracking-wide flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5

micro_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must change color explicitly. Borders lighten from white/10 to white/40.
micro_interactions.focus_states: Visible focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0057FF] focus:outline-none) for accessibility.
micro_interactions.animation: Use subtle Tailwind utility animations (animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-2 duration-300). No exaggerated bouncing.

sentiment_cue.description: Implicitly show sentiment via a small status dot next to the brand name in the header.
sentiment_cue.implementation: A 6px rounded-full dot in the header next to 'Flow AI'. Use the sentiment colors: Green for positive/neutral, Red for frustrated, Yellow for confused. Add a subtle animate-pulse effect.

trust_signals.privacy_badge: Include a small lock icon (🔒 or Shield) in the composer helper text: '🔒 Flow AI confirms with you before acting.'

instructions_to_main_agent: Replace generic sans fonts with 'IBM Plex Sans' for body and 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings in the CSS/Tailwind config.
Remove all indigo-to-violet gradient classes (e.g., from-indigo-500 to-violet-600). The aesthetic is strict monochrome with a single electric blue accent.
Implement the bento grid for the 4 prompt cards using 'gap-4', 'rounded-sm', and hard 'border-white/10' classes.
Update the User message bubble to be solid white background with black text for maximum high-contrast.
Redesign the ActionCard to be a technical, hard-edged table layout (use rounded-sm instead of rounded-2xl). Separate fields with subtle border bottoms.
Refactor the typing indicator from 3 bouncing dots to a blinking terminal block cursor or linear pulse.
Add the sentiment status dot in the header next to the brand name.
Ensure all 'data-testid' attributes are preserved and correctly placed exactly as they were in the original file.
